objective: Base UI + topology cache for ONE mesh: spawn a single deterministically-named broker (mesh1.broker1) and prove it is visible live across all admin-ui surfaces plus a new Cache view, with its boot telemetry landing in Jaeger.
size: small — single engineer, one worktree branch
in_scope: Deterministic node naming <mesh>.<role><N> (mesh1.broker1), assigned by admin-ui on spawn via RAFKA_NODE_NAME (per-mesh/per-role counter)
GossipDigest.location field — node's reachable bind addr, broadcast in gossip; loopback rewrite for 0.0.0.0
GET /api/topology-cache — directory name -> {mesh,type,location} built from live_digests()
Cache tab in the React/Vite admin-ui (admin-ui/web/src) showing the gossiped directory
Single mesh + (+broker) -> mesh1.broker1 visible live in Topology, Nodes, Messages, Boot Waterfall, Timeline, Cache
CPU/RAM usage bars preserved on node cards
exit_criteria: One mesh + (+broker) -> mesh1.broker1 appears in all 5 admin-ui surfaces + the new Cache view
/api/topology-cache returns mesh1.broker1 with a real location (gossip-derived, not hardcoded)
UI SCREENSHOTS captured + in this sprint folder (screenshots/ui-*.png)
JAEGER SCREENSHOT captured + in this folder proving telemetry: service=broker, operation=rafka.mesh.node.ready, the 5-span boot chain (screenshots/jaeger-*.png)
TEAM LEAD personally verified every screenshot
Sprint release doc (sprint-release.md) with embedded screenshots

verification.method: Playwright headless Chromium (docs/plans/mesh-v2/verify/) + raw Jaeger UI capture (jaeger-shot.js); team lead independently ran cargo check, curled /api/topology-cache, and eyeballed every PNG
